title: European Study to Evaluate Preliminary Safety and Efficacy of Multiple Obalon Gastric Balloons for 12 Weeks as an Aid for Weight Loss
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to evaluate the initial safety and preliminary effectiveness of the Obalon intragastric balloon system in European subjects with a BMI in the range of 27 - 35 kg/m\^2
study_population: Patients were selected from investigators' patient population and included patients with a BMI in the range of 27 - 35 kg/m\^2
